roleZh: 上下桥臂分别控制 P–AC 与 AC–N 的开关通路。
roleEn: High-side and low-side switch groups control P–AC and AC–N paths.
featuresZh: 共 8 颗芯片，每臂 4 颗并联。均流、寄生参数和驱动时序不由外观模型验证。
featuresEn: Eight dies, four in parallel per switch. The visual model does not validate current sharing, parasitics or gate timing.
materialZh: 碳化硅芯片；表面金属化与具体器件相关。
